Same rules?

A deal only pays if both apps pick the winner the same way. We read both apps' rules for every deal and answer Yes, Check or No.

Same rules? Yes
Both apps pick the winner the same way: same game, same day, same source.
Same rules? Check
The rules are a little different. Read both before you buy.
Same rules? No
The rules are different, so you could lose on both sides. We hide these unless you turn them on.

This is our reading of the rules, not a promise. When two apps did pick different winners, it's in past deals.

No promise of results

An order can fail to fill or fill only in part. Two markets that look alike can settle differently. Fees can change.

Market data
The prices, order books and rules we show come from Kalshi's, Polymarket's and Polymarket US's public APIs. That data is about markets, not about you.
What we store about you
Your Whop user id and the email address Whop gives us when you sign in. Whop handles sign-in and payment; we never see your card details.
Your plan, your region (US or outside the US) and your settings: filters, and which alerts you turned on.
Push subscriptions for the devices where you turned on alerts, so we can send them.
First-party events (for example: viewed the landing page, opened the feed, started checkout), tied to a random visitor id kept in a cookie. It is not derived from anything personal, and these events are not sent to third parties.
